support_claim: The commercial notes record that legal has not determined which registry entity is the contracting party and instruct that the registry link be treated as unresolved, despite naming overlap between sales and billing forms.
justification: Under the relation contract, SAME_ENTITY and DISTINCT each require establishing evidence, not mere name compatibility; the packet preserves an unresolved registry identity and an additional Wyoming LLC candidate, so neither the positive nor negative identity burden is met for crm:NBA-102 and billing:Northbridge Analytics Inc.
